answer: jetty rations capacity, not badges: it records a delta for every key pair and treats keys whose delta stays under the floor as one operator. That operator keeps k voices only while k decaying sable leases are live, and jetty renews one lease per operator each epoch. First voice: one sable. The kth needs k live sable, so n heads burn 1+...+n serial re-buys; idle clones lapse.
